MINUTES
  ADJOURNED JOINT MEETING OF THE
  CITY COUNCIL, PLANNING COMMISSION, PARK & ACTIVITIES COMMISSION
  APRIL 28, 2026

1.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER

An Adjourned Joint meeting of the City Council, Planning Commission and Park & Activities
Commission of the City of Rolling Hills Estates was called to order at 5:40 PM.

3.  ROLL CALL

City Council Members Present:  Brown Schachter, Huff, Schmitz, Stegura,
  Zerunyan
Planning Commissioners Present:  Nicklas, Romanelli, Schachter
Planning Commissioners Absent:  Medawar, Repp-Loadsman, Victor, Yoo
Park & Activities Commissioners Present:  Pope, Persichina
Park & Activities Commissioners Absent:  Bain, Ciarolla,  Holdsworth,  Johnson,
  McCormick
City Staff Present:  City Manager Greg Grammer
  City Attorney Don Davis
  Assistant City Manager Alexa Davis
  CommDev/PW Director Jeannie Naughton
  City Clerk Lauren Pettit
  Asst to the City Manager Jessica Slawson
  Senior Accountant Fernando Estrada
  Public Works Manager Kirsten Graham
  CommServices Supervisor Rosa Pinuelas
  Administrative Assistant Denise Jaramillo
  Office Assistant Izabela Villalbazo

4.  PUBLIC COMMENT/PUBLIC PRESENTATIONS

None.

5.  DISCUSSION ITEM

A.  BROWN ACT TRAINING / SB 707 COMPLIANCE

City Attorney Davis provided a presentation (as per the agenda material), providing an
overview of the Ralph M. Brown Act, California’s open-meeting law enacted in 1953 to ensure
that the public’s business is conducted transparently. The presentation emphasized the
importance of proper meeting procedures, including posting agendas at least 72 hours in
advance for regular meetings, providing clear descriptions of items, and generally prohibiting
action on non-agendized items except in limited circumstances such as emergencies or urgent
needs arising after posting.
The presentation also reviewed requirements for public access and participation, noting that
meetings must be held in accessible locations without barriers such as fees or registration
requirements, and that the public has the right to attend, review meeting materials, record
proceedings, and provide comment. Overall, the presentation stressed the importance of
transparency, careful adherence to procedural requirements, and consulting legal counsel
when questions arise.

6.  ADJOURNMENT

Adjourned meeting at 6:45 PM to the regular City Council meeting.
